newsitem.title: USA: Gaylord in pact to sell Seattle TV unit.
newsitem.headline: Gaylord in pact to sell Seattle TV unit.

text.p: Gaylord Entertainment Co said Monday it has signed a definitive agreement to sell its KSTW-TV station in Seattle, Wash., to Cox Broadcasting Inc for $160 million.
Gaylord, which announced its plans to sell the CBS-affiliated station in October, said the deal is pending approval by the Federal Communications Commission.
Gaylord is a diversified entertainment and commiunications company that operates Nashville's Grand Ole Opry, cable television networks and broadcast TV and radio stations.

Cox Broadcasting owns and operates 11 TV stations, a movie and TV production company and Cox Radio Inc, as majority-wned publicly-held subsidiary. Cox Broadcasting is a unit of Cox Enterprises Inc, which is engaged in newspaper publishing, braodband communications/cable operations and automobile auctions.
